tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'ching ba rnam grol gyi 'grel pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bo bla ma la phyag 'tshal nas 'di bshad par bya'o/ /rgya gar skad du/ ban+dha bi muk+to pa de sha zhes bya ba/ bod skad du bsgyur na/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces pa'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes 'gyur gyi phyag go/ gzhung chung 'di'i don zab cing rgya che ba yin mod kyi/ tshig don mdo tsam bshad na/ 'dir thog ma kho nar shes rab zab mo'i sgo nas/ 'ching ba rang grol gyi man ngag bstan pa ni/ kye ho gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam/ /'di na 'ching ba gang yang med/ /'ching ba gang yin de grol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ kye ho zhes pa bod pa'o/ /'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog ste/ 'khor ba pa thams cad de'i rang bzhin ma shes pas bcings pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa sems kyi rang zhal lta shes pas nyon mongs dang rnam rtog de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam du 'gyur ro/ / 'di na 'ching bya 'ching byed 'ching ba gang yang dngos gnas la grub pa med pas/ med pa ltar ngo 'phrod na/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'ching bar byed pa gang yin pa des/ rnal 'byor pa grol bar 'gyur ba'o/ /tshigs rkang dang pos rgyu gzhi dus dang*/ gnyis pas lam dang*/ lhag ma gnyis kyis 'bras bu'ang bstan pa yin no/ /de nas thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas/ 'ching ba rang grol gyi man ngag ni/ 'dod chags bde ba chen por dag /zhe sdang 'od gsal me lce 'bar/ /gti mug rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /dug gsum sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs te/ rang bzhin stong nyid ngo shes lam 'khyer du ma zad/ thabs zab khyad can 'di yang yod de/ 'dod chags ched kyis ma spangs par zhu bde bsgom pa'i rkyen gyis rang bzhin bde chen mngon du 'gyur ba'o/ /zhe sdang gi gsal cha de nyid 'od gsal gsal stong du 'char ba dang*/

shes pa had po dang gnyid 'thug po sogs gti mug kha rgyal bar yang*/ mi rtog pa'i yon tan rang chas su yod pas/ rnam par mi rtog pas lam du btang ngo*/ /'dod chags bde ba longs sku/ zhe sdang gsal ba sprul sku/ gti mug mi rtog pa chos sku rnams su gdod ma lhun grub tu gnas pa de thabs kyis lam du bsral bar bya'o/ /rgya gar gyi grub thob chen po shrī dza gat+ma tra ā nan+tā'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag rdzogs so/ /zhes pa ni/ /mdzad byang lo tsā bas bcug pa'o/ /rgya gar gyi slob dpon de nyid dang lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes pa ni 'gyur byang ngo*/ /'di'i dge bas gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur bar shog cig / rgyas par khro phu ba'i 'grel par blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang*/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag /maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'ching ba rnam grol gyi 'grel pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 11 -- PAGE 10 -
